capacity_definition: Additional production units available beyond each factory's baseline, over the complete sample replay horizon; not units per day
notes: Null means unknown; zero capacity and an empty compatibility list are real restrictions
Supplied values are enforced even when unverified, but unverified constraints do not establish feasibility
Verified flags require a documented source_reference and a matching horizon
Each proposed whole-product move consumes Source Units, including unmapped demand, at the receiving factory
Origin capacity released by a move is reported but is not reused in this conservative single-pass portfolio
